In the Islamic tradition, the Prophet Ibrahim is the recipient of God's covenant, which includes the commitment to be a source of guidance and blessings for all of humanity. As we go through life, the name Ishaaq can serve as a reminder of God's presence and promise, and an inspiration to strive for inner and outer excellence in all that we do.
